shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat vertical face
justification: Both show a free-standing, roughly rectangular stone slab bearing shallow relief carving on its flat vertical face, set among coursed or piled stonework, which gives a broadly comparable overall impression of a carved upright monument. Beyond that the correspondence is generic: B is a close view with legible animal figures, a horizontal band of repeated notched motifs and a register of arched forms, whereas A is a distant view whose surface design is largely illegible and whose composition, scale and rendering therefore cannot be matched.
